caption: We imported a made up file of 20 contacts (20 valid, 0 invalid) and built this Lead pipeline view by Lifecycle Stage in about 5 minutes and 25 clicks. Record Matching defaulted to First Name, which would have merged our rows. Contact details of the sample records are hidden.
The MCP page connects ChatGPT, Claude or Grok over OAuth instead of an API key. We did not connect one, because it needs a sign in with an outside account, and the page names no plan limit.
An API key could be created on the Business trial without a card. We masked the key, never used it and revoked it afterwards.
Billed yearly, Pro is $29 and Business $59 per seat a month ($39 and $79 monthly). The Business card says 5.000 AI chats, emails and enrichments, while the public pricing page lists 10,000.
Billing has no cancel button, only Downgrade to Pro. Leaving means Delete Organization in the Danger Zone, which we did not click. The trial asked for no card.
